narrative.overview: The accepted black, ivory, acid and ice WebGL world extends into a conversational career workspace. Fictional sample journeys remain visibly separate from native personal records and explicit model requests.

Explicit sample provenance and execution boundaries
Central scroll-linked sourcing story with manual/static fallbacks and explicit watcher simulation
dos: Preserve the accepted hero and trajectory geometry.
